chapter: Learning trombone and the Wisconsin Roof years
title: Percy the trombonist
summary: Percy, a jazz trombonist whose last name he never knew.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Who was this guy, Percy, you were saying? I guess it was back at Bill Bottoms or something.

Percy? Yeah. I mentioned Percy as trombones. Well you didn't say what he played. Yeah, he played trombones. But I never did know, and I never did know his last name. He was a good musician. He wasn't such a good musician. He could play well, but I mean as far as reading music. He was more of a jazz man. Yeah, more of a jazz man, yeah.
